title: An object storage bucket lists its contents
summary: The site returns a bucket listing, which means the storage behind it is public and every object key can be read.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and body_contains("<ListBucketResult") and body_contains("<Key>") and body_differs(control) and not body_contains("<html")

remediate: Make the bucket private and serve it through an application that checks access.
